evidence.quote: The language of the programme is English.

name.fr: Copie de la carte d'identité / du passeport

evidence.quote: Generally, you'll need the following documents to apply to THA: High school diploma or equivalent If you have a foreign high school diploma, you’ll also need an officially certified translation and the preliminary review documentation (VPD) from uni-assist.ev or the Bavarian Certificate Recognition Office For Master’s applications, you’ll also need your bachelor’s degree or university diploma Resume in table format / form Copy of ID card / passport If available: Certificate of completion of mandatory service (e.g., military service, Federal Voluntary Service) For admission based on professional qualifications: Proof of completed vocational training, work experience, and the counseling interview Transcript of grades when applying for a higher semester If applicable, consent from legal guardians for minors / form

notes: Les frais de scolarité sont indiqués comme « None » par semestre ; il s'agit d'une information générale pour le programme, sans distinction entre étudiants UE et non-UE. La contribution semestrielle n'est pas incluse dans les frais de scolarité. Aucun document n'est explicitement listé sur la page DAAD du programme ; les documents proviennent de la FAQ générale de l'université.

note.fr: Un test d'aptitude est requis dans le cadre de la procédure de sélection.
note.en: An aptitude test is required as part of the selection procedure.

evidence.quote: Selection procedure via an aptitude test: Apply via HISinOne and upload the required application documents.

note.fr: Si vous avez un diplôme étranger, soumettez vos documents à uni-assist pour la VPD (peut prendre jusqu'à 8 semaines).
note.en: If you have a foreign diploma, submit your documents to uni-assist for the VPD (can take up to 8 weeks).

evidence.quote: If you did not earn your academic credentials (transcript, diploma) in the Federal Republic of Germany, you must submit them to Technical University of Applied Sciences Augsburg c/o uni-assist e.V. , D-11507 Berlin , service@uni-assist.de for evaluation and recognition.

note.fr: Il est recommandé de fournir un test d'anglais B2, mais aucune preuve n'est exigée.
note.en: A B2 English test is recommended but no proof is required.

evidence.quote: English language skills B2 required/recommended, no proof required
